classes.name: Slayer
classes.gauge:
Vital Points (3 strikes)

Each skill will cause 1 of the following debuffs

Head vital point -> increase the damage done by the player that stacks 3x
Body vital point -> decrease def that stacks 3x

After the 3 stacks on the 3 points reached, consume all 9 stacks to do a blood damage based on target max HP
Leg vital point -> cause small slow that stacks 3x

classes.name: Highlander
classes.gauge:
Immortal body

If HP reaches 0, does not die and stay immune to damage for 5s then revives with 50% and def buff

classes.name: Light Storm
classes.gauge: Charges: each skill adds positive or negative charges. Even: more poise (stagger) damage. More positive: more lightning damage and penetration. More negative: more crit chance, crit damage and poise damage. When one side reaches 100% and the other 0%, an overcharge starts: a positive overcharge raises lightning damage and makes hits chain to a second target; a negative overcharge makes every hit a crit for 5 s. Then the bar returns to 50/50

classes.name: Dragoon

classes.name: General

classes.name: Fire Heart
classes.gauge:
Spirit of Fire: Each skill that hits an enimy provides fire stacks to fill the bar

When the bar is full, Spirit of Fire is triggered incresing the fire damage, fire resistance and area of effect of the fire skills

classes.name: Sniper

classes.name: Elemental Shooter
